what.text: The company operates in various sectors including infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, technology, financial services, and realty. It focuses on delivering complex projects and innovative solutions to drive growth and sustainability.

segments.name: Infrastructure & Utilities
segments.text: This segment involves conceptualizing, designing, executing, and commissioning large projects across various domains. It includes buildings, transportation, power, and water management.

segments.name: Energy - Conventional
segments.text: This segment focuses on hydrocarbon projects and carbon solutions, enhancing operational specialization for efficient project delivery.

segments.name: Energy - Green
segments.text: This segment addresses renewable energy infrastructure, leveraging capabilities in solar and wind energy to support the transition to sustainable systems.

segments.name: Manufacturing & Products
segments.text: This segment designs and engineers equipment for various industries, including defense and aerospace, and focuses on high-value sectors.

segments.name: Technology, Platforms & Services
segments.text: This segment encompasses IT services, engineering R&D, and digital platforms, aiming to strengthen the company's digital ecosystem.

verdict.headline: Larsen & Toubro shows strong revenue growth but missed FY26 guidance.

narrative_vs_numbers.text: Management's narrative of achieving a 15% revenue growth in FY26 was not met, as actual growth was 11.8%. However, the company did achieve significant revenue growth from ₹221,113 Cr in FY24 to ₹285,874 Cr in FY26.

bull.text: Larsen & Toubro's annual revenue grew significantly from ₹221,113 Cr in FY24 to ₹285,874 Cr in FY26.
The company achieved a strong quarterly revenue growth of 15.8% year on year in Sep 2026.
Net profit increased from ₹15,547 Cr in FY24 to ₹18,954 Cr in FY26, showing robust profitability.

bear.text: The company missed its FY26 revenue growth guidance of 15%, achieving only 11.8%.
Borrowings increased to ₹140,300 Cr in Sep 2026, raising concerns about rising debt levels.
The operating margin decreased by 2 percentage points from Sep 2025 to Sep 2026.
